submitted_sql: SELECT il.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY il.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, il.track_id ASC LIMIT 1;
validated_sql: SELECT il.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line AS il JOIN public.invoice AS i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY il.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, il.track_id ASC LIMIT 1
